changeSet.author: arena
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE arena.customer ADD COLUMN version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; ALTER TABLE arena.customer_subscription ADD COLUMN version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; ALTER TABLE arena.customer_subscription ADD COLUMN billing_plan_id VARCHAR(40); CREATE TABLE arena.billing_order ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, customer_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES arena.customer(id), subscription_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES arena.customer_subscription(id), request_id UUID NOT NULL, plan_id VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, plan_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, cycle VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CHECK (cycle IN ('MONTHLY','ANNUAL')), base_amount NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (base_amount > 0), tax_amount NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (tax_amount >= 0), total NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (total = base_amount + tax_amount), currency VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('CREATED','PAYMENT_PENDING','PAID','FAILED','CANCELLED')), created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT ux_billing_order_request UNIQUE(customer_id, request_id) ); CREATE INDEX idx_billing_order_customer_status ON arena.billing_order(customer_id,status,created_at); CREATE TABLE arena.billing_attempt ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES arena.billing_order(id), provider VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, provider_reference VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, amount NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0), currency VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PAYMENT_PENDING','PAID','FAILED','CANCELLED')), created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, completed_at TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT ux_billing_attempt_provider UNIQUE(provider,provider_reference) ); CREATE INDEX idx_billing_attempt_order ON arena.billing_attempt(order_id,created_at); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_billing_attempt_pending ON arena.billing_attempt(order_id) WHERE status='PAYMENT_PENDING';

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE arena.billing_attempt; DROP TABLE arena.billing_order; ALTER TABLE arena.customer DROP COLUMN version; ALTER TABLE arena.customer_subscription DROP COLUMN version; ALTER TABLE arena.customer_subscription DROP COLUMN billing_plan_id;
